about: The 1989 wall cash dispenser (distributeur automatique de billets) for LF_ATM.et: a beige-painted steel fascia in a steel mounting plate on a brushed-steel base, a green-on-black CRT screen with a small hood, side keys, a metal keypad, a card slot, a ticket slot, a cash slot and a blue bank sign plate that reads only BANQUE. Built by build.py in headless Blender from simple geometry and procedural textures: no library model fit (the base game has no cash machine, the CC0 libraries only a cash register) and no Meshy credits. Core asset: the machine is a capability of the game, its text is neutral, and no bank brand is on it.

layout_m.about: Enfusion metres: x right, y up, z forward; the front faces +z. The ORIGIN is on the ground and the BACK of the mounting plate is the plane z -0.30: the vanilla Safe_01 this replaces had its back at z -0.300 too, so every placed ATM (they were seated flush to a wall by that back plane, #3355) stays flush without a move.
